name: sit_sideways
text: A person sits sideways on a park bench, turning the hips and legs to the left while the torso turns gently back toward the front. The left arm rests along the top of the bench backrest behind the body, right hand on the thigh. Remain comfortably seated on a 45cm-high seat, feet on the ground. Keep the knees together and pointing diagonally left and forward, feet on the floor in front of the bench. The left forearm rests above the backrest, never through the board.
